div.div: غَلَسٌ The darkness of the last part of the night, (S, A, Msb, K,) when it becomes mixed with the light of the dawn: (TA:) or the beginning of the dawn, until it spreads in the tracts of the horizon: as also غَبَسٌ: both signify blackness mixed with whiteness and redness; like the dawn. (Az, TA.) بِغَلَسٍ In a period of the darkness so called. (S, Msb, K.) [See also غَبَشٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
